published_source.title: The art of trellis decoding is fixed-parameter tractable
published_source.normalized_statement: If B<=Bprime and span(Varr) INTER Bprime <= B, then FS_k(Varr,Bprime)=up_k(FS_k(Varr,B),Bprime).

general_theorem.quantification: FOR_ALL finite-dimensional GF(2) ambient spaces A, finite subspace arrangements Varr, subspaces B<=Bprime<=A satisfying span(Varr) INTER Bprime <= B, and integers k>=0
general_theorem.semantic_reason: Under the precondition every W<=span(Varr) has W INTER Bprime <= B, so canonical B-trajectories and Bprime-trajectories of each layout coincide; realizability is therefore the same and transitivity of the trajectory preorder yields the full-set identity.

local_semantic_mapping.expand_trajectory: Local B3 expand_trajectory is identity on the trajectory statistics while validating child boundary <= parent boundary and recording boundary transport.
local_semantic_mapping.up_k: Local B2 up_k closure realizes the same compact width<=k upward coverage relation after boundary expansion.
local_semantic_mapping.caller_precondition_ceiling: The local expand_trajectory function does not receive Varr and therefore cannot itself prove span(Varr) INTER Bprime <= B. Semantic use of Proposition 4.2 requires a separately bound caller/decomposition precondition certificate.
